### Gold Sponsor

```{r}
#| label: sponsor-gold
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig.align: center

gold_logos <- c(
  "asset/sponsor/gold.png",
  "asset/sponsor/gold.png",
  "asset/sponsor/gold.png"
)

make_logo_grid(
  gold_logos,
  max_per_row = 2,
  height = 220
)

```
:::

# Get in Touch! {.mt-1}

:::: {.grid .gap-4}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-7}
```{=html}
<form action="https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxxx" method="POST">

  <div class="form-group mb-3">
    <label for="name">Name</label>
    <input
      type="text"
      id="name"
      name="Name"
      class="form-control"
      required>
  </div>

  <div class="form-grid-2">
    <div class="form-group mb-3">
      <label for="email">Email</label>
      <div class="input-group">
        <span class="input-group-text bi bi-envelope">
        </span>
        <input
          type="email"
          id="email"
          name="Email"
          class="form-control"
          required>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="form-group mb-3">
      <label for="phone">Phone Number</label>
      <div class="input-group">
        <span class="input-group-text bi bi-telephone">
        </span>
        <input
          type="tel"
          id="phone"
          name="Phone Number"
          class="form-control"
          required>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="form-group mb-3">
    <label for="message">Message</label>
    <textarea
      id="message"
      name="Message"
      rows="3"
      class="form-control"
      required></textarea>
  </div>

  <div class="form-check mb-3">
    <input
      class="form-check-input"
      type="checkbox"
      id="gridCheck"
      required>
    <label class="form-check-label ms-2" for="gridCheck">
      I agreed with terms and privacy.
    </label>
  </div>

  <button
    type="submit"
    class="btn-primary btn-action btn btn-lg btn-block w-100 rounded
      role="button"">
    <i class="bi bi-arrow-right-circle-fill me-2"></i>Submit
  </button>
</form>
```

:::
